Help [[Ashford]] farmer [[Pitney]] clear a nasty [[worm]] infestation from his fields.

==Quest information==
===Requirements===
{{ Standard prerequisites
| campaign = pre
| test = n
}}

===Objectives===
* Acquire a [[devourer egg]] from [[Fadden Hathorn]] in the [[devourer cave]].
* Take the devourer egg to [[Pitney]] in [[Ashford]].
* Follow Pitney and kill the [[Worm Queen|Queen Worm]].
* Return to Pitney for your reward.

===Reward===
* 250 [[Experience]]
* 50 [[Gold]] ({{reforgedmode}} only)
* [[Fire Wand]]
** [[Fire Dmg]]: 3-5
** Halves skill [[recharge]] of spells (Chance: 5%)
** [[Energy]] +3 (while [[Health]] is above 50%)

===Environmental changes===
* Once you kill the Worm Queen, even before turning the quest in, slightly fewer [[Plague Worm]]s will spawn in the area.

==Walkthrough==
Your first task is getting a devourer egg to use as bait. You can earn two by completing [[The Egg Hunter]] quest involving Fadden Hathorn, to whom Pitney directs you at first. Alternatively, you can barter for one with local collectors: trade 5 [[Skale Fin (Pre-Searing)|skale fins]] to [[Brownlow]] or 3 [[dull carapace]]s to [[Rownan]].

Hand the egg over and follow Pitney to his field. He will use the bait to draw the Worm Queen out of the ground alongside several Plague Worms, who are hostile (in contrast to all the others in the area).

It is useful to clear out any roaming [[Wolf|wolves]] nearby before engaging the queen to avoid getting overwhelmed, especially at lower levels.

Once the queen is slain, talk to Pitney (who should be standing nearby) for your reward.
